description: This file defines the TelegramBot class implementing the Bot interface; it provides methods to send messages, images, animations, and documents through the Telegram API using unreal4u	elegram library. It also has functionality to set webhooks for the bot.

classes.name: TelegramBot
classes.description: A class implementing a Telegram bot to send messages, images, animations, documents, and set webhooks using the unreal4u	elegram library.

methods.name: createBot
methods.description: Initializes the Telegram bot, setting up the event loop, request handler, and logging, with error handling for configuration exceptions.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a plain text message to a specified chat ID.

methods.name: sendImage
methods.description: Sends an image with a caption to a specified chat ID.

methods.name: sendAnimation
methods.description: Sends an animation (GIF/video) with a caption to a specified chat ID, handling errors asynchronously.

methods.name: sendDocument
methods.description: Sends a document with a caption to a specified chat ID, handling errors asynchronously.

methods.name: setWebhook
methods.description: Sets the webhook URL for receiving updates, using configuration parameters.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the configured name of the Telegram bot.
